objective: Build the canonical architecture-level threat model for NEXUS QUANT against the frozen G2 architecture, covering identity, data integrity, agents/LLMs, execution, supply chain, secrets, recovery and audit threats with explicit severity and remediation ownership.
scope: Identify protected assets and security objectives
Map P02 trust boundaries and attack surfaces
Identify external, insider, compromised-provider and supply-chain threat actors
Add agent/LLM prompt-injection and tool-abuse threats
Assign severity, security objective, owner phase and control direction
Create machine-readable threat register and threat diagrams
out_of_scope: Enable Demo, Shadow, Canary, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Threat model traces to FROZEN_G2 trust zones and authority boundaries
Every critical asset has confidentiality/integrity/availability objectives
Every trust boundary has at least one analyzed threat class
Agent/LLM prompt injection and tool abuse are explicitly modeled
Market-data integrity and execution uncertainty are explicitly modeled
Every HIGH/CRITICAL threat has an owning future control workstream
No security control is claimed implemented when it is only planned
security_tests: No secrets/credentials are created or exposed
Threat model includes credential theft and withdrawal-permission abuse
Threat model includes A5/A8 veto bypass attempts
Threat model includes cross-environment privilege escalation
Threat model includes fail-closed behavior where security truth is unknown
rollback: Revert P03-A threat-model artifacts and state/catalog changes. No runtime security configuration or credentials are changed.
definition_of_done: Threat register is canonical and severity-assigned
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
